description: US healthcare providers from the NPPES NPI Registry: look up one by its 10-digit NPI (check digit verified) or search by name with an optional state. Each provider gives type, name, credential, status, primary taxonomy and practice address. Information only, not medical advice. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
